evidence: The structural observation is accurate, but the required demonstration stops before a material contradiction of the selected contract. At the frozen implementation, invitation_content.rs:289-415 selects every State field, copies text into a JSON map, converts it to State and serializes State again for numeric validation. render_selection():600-639 uses this accessor for frozen identity; service/delivery_presentation.rs:137-139 calls it before the deciding store pull, and invitation_content.rs:2127 and :2170 repeat the metadata read and then load State. refresh():2945 loads the same payload and :3080 unconditionally invokes save(); save():473-520 serializes all fields, clones text into SQL values and assigns all fields in the upsert. The proposed narrower pattern actually exists in presentation_reader.rs:94-155. Thus this is a concrete optimization opportunity introduced by this diff, not an invented call path: the base 565def86 has no invitation_content.rs. The strongest source-only scenario is an admitted Live V2 Watch binding retaining ordinary carry/partial and a frozen outbox while canonical source truth is quiet. workers.rs:1144-1181 still invokes the registry safety pass every ten one-second ticks, mod_channels.rs:434 calls presentation_refresh for that binding, and store/mod.rs:1240-1244 performs its full-row refresh inside the serialized writer decision. It therefore reads/copies and submits unchanged presentation payload again even when passive progress remains unchanged. However, the four cited payloads have explicit fixed ceilings (155731/49415/262144/65536 bytes in migration 0044:68,70,82,83, also checked before allocation in load_raw), totaling at most 532826 bytes for those fields; the demonstration is bounded repeated work, not a retained-history scan or an unbounded body allocation. The selected Q3 design R3 requires bounded private sources instead of legacy aggregates, R7 preserves the numeric work/output/storage envelopes, and its service/registry split explicitly selects bounded presentation_refresh. None promises payload-independent metadata cost or a narrow-column UPDATE. Crucially Q3 design:95 explicitly acknowledges 'every refresh saves that table' and preserves the ten-tick safety pass rather than forbidding that save. TRUST-POLICY:1584-1608 bounds physical publication visits/probes and permits retained-history convergence across bounded calls; this accessor does not exceed those counts, alter output, reset captured progress or manufacture wake authority. The narrow reader helper's own fixed-query requirement does not apply to all refresh/identity accessors. A full-row SQL assignment preserving existing bytes is also not evidence that parked ordinary progress changed. No measured latency, allocation-budget or serialized-writer failure is supplied, and the finding expressly disclaims an unmeasured wall-clock breach. Consequently the end-to-end reproduction establishes unnecessary bounded payload handling but not loss, failed delivery, a stated hot-path budget breach or another material contract failure. Confirming it would impose an unstated requirement that these accessors operate independently of retained payload size. REJECT under the supplied REPRODUCE materiality rule; no external-fact premise or research is needed for this internal structural judgment.
